name: fraud-detection
description: Real-time credit card fraud detection: calibrated Random Forest served by FastAPI, SHAP explanations, Supabase Realtime, React analyst dashboard, drift monitoring. Live demo on Vercel + Render.

paragraphs: An end-to-end fraud detection system: machine-learning models trained on 284,807 real credit card transactions, served through a low-latency FastAPI service, fed by a real-time transaction stream, stored in Supabase, and monitored from a live React analyst dashboard. Every transaction gets a fraud probability, a LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH risk level, and a SHAP explanation of why — and analysts can review alerts and send feedback, just like in a production fraud operations team.
features: Time-based train / validation / test split (no data leakage from the future)
Four models compared: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost
Three imbalance strategies compared: class weights, SMOTE, undersampling (fraud is only 0.17% of data)
Evaluated with metrics that matter for rare events: PR-AUC, precision, recall, F1, recall at 90% precision, and dollars saved — not accuracy
Cost-based decision threshold (missed fraud vs. analyst review cost)

requirements.text: Secure analyst login (Supabase Auth + Row Level Security); dark and light themes; works on phones
Security: the browser only ever holds the Supabase publishable key and the analyst's login token, so Row Level Security decides what it may read or change.
Only for logged-in analysts: send the Supabase access token of an analyst session.
